title: Oracle call specification
statement: For a machine state $s$, define a call specification as follows: in phase ask, call decider $0$ in whole-input mode with the added tape as its sole argument, continuing in phase bit after a positive answer and in phase work$(\\mathrm{none},\\mathrm{false})$ after a negative answer; in phase bit, call decider $1$ in whole-input mode with that same sole argument, continuing in phase work$(\\mathrm{some}\\,\\mathrm{true},\\mathrm{false})$ after a positive answer and phase work$(\\mathrm{some}\\,\\mathrm{false},\\mathrm{false})$ after a negative answer. In every other phase, there is no call.
